parser.commentExpr: (?x) (?s:\x2F\x2A.*?\x2A\x2F) # Multi Line Comment | (?m-s:(?:\x23|\x2F{2}).*$) # Single line comment # or //

function.mainExpr:
(?x) ^\h* # Start of the line (?:(?:public|private|protected|async|sync)\s+)* # Ignore modifiers; we want just the definition (?: # --- 1. Assets --- <\s*(?:script|style)\b[^>]*> | # --- 2. Keywords --- (?:function|route|view|method|prop|const|static|readonly)
# --- 3. De Naam/Definitie (De Magic Fix) --- # Capture everything (non-greedy) that is NOT an operator [^:={}=;(\r\n]*
# Optionally capture the parentheses (arguments) too (?: \s* \( [^)]* \) )?
# --- 4. Het Stopmoment (Lookahead) --- # Stop matching at one of these characters, # or the end of the line. (?= \s*[:={}=] # Een operator: : = { } => | \s*; # A semicolon | \s*$ # End of the line (important for props!) ) )
